# Survey Notes: Mitigating Model Uncertainty in Self-Adaptive Systems

**Generated by**: concept_extractor

## Implementation Overview

This research aims to explore the effectiveness of stacking-based ensemble methods as a replacement for Bayesian Model Averaging (BMA) within the MAPE-K loop of self-adaptive systems. The objective is to reduce model-selection uncertainty, leveraging out-of-fold predictions to improve prediction accuracy and adaptation decision metrics without compromising computational cost.
